fc.flagHelp: Step {{step}}: markers show the model's native lead times (or aggregates of a finer step); between markers, values are interpolated (U/V). Exports carry the time_flag column.
fc.chartDir: Direction at {{height}} (where the wind comes from)
fc.roseHelp: Native lead times only, all points and members: {{n}} values, mean speed {{mean}} m/s.
fc.needTwo: Download at least two models to compare them.
fc.comparisonHelp: 3 h step, mean of the selected points (and members for ensembles), {{n}} common times. MMM: multi-model mean (reference, not an observation).

ds.title: Data sources
ds.help: Paid sources stay disabled until an administrator enables them; each request must then accept them explicitly, and the choice is recorded.

arch.title: Automatic archiving
arch.help: Every hour, new runs of the ticked models are downloaded at the selected points of each site. Essential for ICON (DWD keeps ~24 h only) and for calibration (milestone 6).
